project_rail.title: Install the control namespace
project_rail.why: Nothing can be governed until the project has a frozen identity and a source of truth.

project_rail.title: Lock the active goal
project_rail.why: ABS.REQ.GOAL_LOCK.002 rejects material action that has no valid upward goal link.

project_rail.title: Open one bounded work packet
project_rail.why: Work is executed as one reversible, bounded unit with declared rollback.

project_rail.title: Create the governed documents
project_rail.why: The framework's unit of knowledge is the canonical module package, not a loose file.

project_rail.title: Author every representation in lockstep
project_rail.why: ABS.REQ.DOCUMENT_BLUEPRINT_PARITY.002 requires representations to be authored section-by-section, not back-filled.

project_rail.title: Seal and stamp every document into the source of truth
project_rail.why: An unstamped document has no identity, so no later claim can be bound to it.

project_rail.title: Record evidence for the active work packet
project_rail.why: ABS.REQ.EVIDENCE_GATES: a completion claim without evidence bound to an exact hash is not a claim.

project_rail.title: Evaluate the evidence gate
project_rail.why: The gate is what converts recorded evidence into a permitted state change.

project_rail.title: Complete the bounded work packet
project_rail.why: A packet may only close once its own gate passed against the current identity.

project_rail.title: Write a restart-safe session checkpoint
project_rail.why: Recovery must not depend on a live context that can be lost.

project_rail.title: Review the frozen whole (pass 2)
project_rail.why: ABS.REQ.LIFECYCLE_TWO_PASS.002: pass 1 builds the candidate, pass 2 reviews it frozen.

project_rail.title: Run deterministic deep verification and record it
project_rail.why: Every claim in the project must be reproducible from raw bytes by a fresh process.

project_rail.title: Assemble the release
project_rail.why: Release is the only step that produces an externally shippable identity.
